## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/objects

**List objects** — `listObjects`

Returns rental objects under reachable buildings for the selected `{mode}`.

Objects are the lowest level of the resource hierarchy (`Mandate → Property → Building → Object`). Each object carries a `buildingId` FK that resolves via `getBuilding`.

Scope with `filter[buildingId]`, `filter[propertyId]`, or `filter[mandateId]` to narrow the result set. Use `q` for free-text search across name, EWID, building name, and street.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name, ewid, buildingName, street. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[propertyId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given property id. |
| `filter[buildingId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given building id. |
| `filter[mandateId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given mandate id. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name` \| `-name` \| `area` \| `-area` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name, area. |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name, ewid, buildingName, street
- **Filterable:** `filter[propertyId]`, `filter[buildingId]`, `filter[mandateId]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name`, `area` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [ObjectApiResponse](#objectapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "buildingId": 1,
      "name": "string",
      "type": "residential_apartment",
      "numberOfRooms": "3.5",
      "area": "85.4",
      "volume": "215",
      "floor": 2,
      "ewid": "001",
      "quota": 50,
      "hasVotingRight": true
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/objects/{id}

**Get object details** — `getObject`

Returns a single rental object by id, including its type, dimensions, floor, EWID, and (for condo objects) ownership quota and voting right.

Use `listObjects` for discovery when the id is unknown. The `buildingId` FK links back to `getBuilding`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**Response** — `200` returns [ObjectApiResponse](#objectapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Object not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "buildingId": 1,
  "name": "string",
  "type": "residential_apartment",
  "numberOfRooms": "3.5",
  "area": "85.4",
  "volume": "215",
  "floor": 2,
  "ewid": "001",
  "quota": 50,
  "hasVotingRight": true
}
```

## Schemas

### ObjectApiResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | yes |  |
| `buildingId` | integer | yes | FK to the parent building. Resolve via `getBuilding`. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | [ObjectType](#objecttype) | yes |  |
| `numberOfRooms` | string | yes | Number of rooms as a decimal string (e.g. "3.5"). Trailing zeros are trimmed. Sent as a string — never a float — to preserve precision. |
| `area` | string | yes | Net floor area in m² as a decimal string. Trailing zeros are trimmed. Sent as a string — never a float — to preserve precision. |
| `volume` | string | yes | Volume in m³ as a decimal string. Trailing zeros are trimmed. Sent as a string — never a float — to preserve precision. |
| `floor` | integer | yes | Floor on which the object is located. Ground floor is 0; basement floors are negative. |
| `ewid` | string · nullable |  | Swiss federal dwelling identifier (EWID), unique within an EGID. Null when the object has no EWID on record. |
| `quota` | integer · nullable |  | Condominium ownership share. Set on condo objects; null for rental objects. |
| `hasVotingRight` | boolean | yes | Whether the owner of this object holds a voting right at the condominium assembly. Meaningful for condo objects; defaults to false otherwise. |

# OpeningBalance

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/{mode}/opening-balances` | `listOpeningBalances` | List opening balances |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/{mode}/opening-balances/{id}` | `getOpeningBalance` | Get an opening balance |

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/opening-balances

**List opening balances** — `listOpeningBalances`

Returns the opening balances (starting balances of balance-sheet accounts at the
beginning of a fiscal year) reachable for the selected `{mode}`. Combined with the
year's bookings, a consumer can reconstruct running balances.

The primary use is `filter[fiscalYearId]` — all opening balances of a year. Narrow
further with `filter[accountId]` or `filter[propertyId]`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of the searchable fields. Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[fiscalYearId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given fiscalYear id. |
| `filter[accountId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given account id. |
| `filter[propertyId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given property id. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `accountId` \| `-accountId` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, accountId. |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** Free-text search
- **Filterable:** `filter[fiscalYearId]`, `filter[accountId]`, `filter[propertyId]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `accountId` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [OpeningBalanceApiResponse](#openingbalanceapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "fiscalYearId": 31,
      "accountId": 12,
      "propertyId": 7,
      "amount": "15230.45"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/opening-balances/{id}

**Get an opening balance** — `getOpeningBalance`

Returns a single opening balance by id. Returns 404 when it does not exist, is
outside the token's scope, or does not belong to the selected `{mode}`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**Response** — `200` returns [OpeningBalanceApiResponse](#openingbalanceapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Opening balance not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "fiscalYearId": 31,
  "accountId": 12,
  "propertyId": 7,

```

## Schemas

### OpeningBalanceApiResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | yes |  |

| `accountId` | integer | yes | FK to the account. Resolve via `getAccount`. |
| `propertyId` | integer | yes | FK to the property — opening balances are always per property, even under a consolidation fiscal year. |
| `amount` | string | yes | Opening balance as a fixed two-decimal string. Negative for credit-side balances. Sent as a string — never a float — to preserve precision. |

# Owner

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/condo/owners` | `listOwners` | List condo owners |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/condo/owners/{id}/files` | `listOwnerFiles` | List files of a condo owner |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/condo/owners/{id}` | `getOwner` | Get condo owner details |

## GET /public-api/v1/condo/owners

**List condo owners** — `listOwners`

Returns condo ownership relations (Stockwerkeigentümer) reachable by the token.
Vacancy contracts are filtered out. Each row carries the derived `status`, the
unit's `quota` and `hasVotingRight`, the linked `persons`, and the
`currentContribution` effective today; the full contribution history is on the
detail endpoint.

Narrow with `filter[status]`, `filter[personId]`, `filter[objectId]`,
`filter[propertyId]` or `filter[mandateId]`. Use `q` to search by linked person
name.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name1, name2. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[status]` | query | string: `upcoming` \| `active` \| `terminated` |  | Restricts results to records matching the given status. |
| `filter[personId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given person id. |
| `filter[objectId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given object id. |
| `filter[propertyId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given property id. |
| `filter[mandateId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given mandate id. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `starts` \| `-starts` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, starts. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name1, name2
- **Filterable:** `filter[status]` (`upcoming`, `active`, `terminated`), `filter[personId]`, `filter[objectId]`, `filter[propertyId]`, `filter[mandateId]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `starts` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [OwnerApiResponse](#ownerapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "objectId": 640,
      "status": "upcoming",
      "starts": "2019-07-01",
      "ends": "2025-01-31",
      "quota": 85,
      "hasVotingRight": true,
      "qrReference": "string",
      "persons": [
        {
          "personId": 123,
          "roles": [
            "tenant"
          ],
          "isPrimary": true
        }
      ],
      "currentContribution": {
        "starts": "2026-01-01",
        "ends": "2025-01-31",
        "amount": "1200.00",
        "amountMonthly": "400.00",
        "billingCycle": 3,
        "positions": [
          {
            "name": "Heizkosten",
            "settlementMode": "flat",
            "amount": "80.00"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/condo/owners/{id}

**Get condo owner details** — `getOwner`

Returns a single condo ownership relation by id, including the unit's `quota`
and `hasVotingRight`, the linked `persons`, the `currentContribution`, and the full
`contributions` history. Returns 404 when the relation does not exist, is not a
condo relation, or is outside the token's scope.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**Response** — `200` returns [OwnerDetailApiResponse](#ownerdetailapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Owner not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "contributions": [
    {
      "starts": "2026-01-01",
      "ends": "2025-01-31",
      "amount": "1200.00",
      "amountMonthly": "400.00",
      "billingCycle": 3,
      "positions": [
        {
          "name": "Heizkosten",
          "settlementMode": "flat",
          "amount": "80.00"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "id": 1,
  "objectId": 640,
  "status": "upcoming",
  "starts": "2019-07-01",
  "ends": "2025-01-31",
  "quota": 85,
  "hasVotingRight": true,
  "qrReference": "string",
  "persons": [
    {
      "personId": 123,
      "roles": [
        "tenant"
      ],
      "isPrimary": true
    }
  ],
  "currentContribution": {
    "starts": "2026-01-01",
    "ends": "2025-01-31",
    "amount": "1200.00",
    "amountMonthly": "400.00",
    "billingCycle": 3,
    "positions": [
      {
        "name": "Heizkosten",
        "settlementMode": "flat",
        "amount": "80.00"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schemas

### OwnerApiResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | yes |  |
| `objectId` | integer | yes | FK to the object resource. Resolve via `getObject`. |
| `status` | [OwnerStatus](#ownerstatus) | yes |  |
| `starts` | string (date) | yes | Ownership start. |
| `ends` | string (date) · nullable |  | Ownership end (e.g. on sale); null while ongoing. |
| `quota` | integer · nullable |  | Wertquota of the unit (ownership share, per-mille); null if not set. |
| `hasVotingRight` | boolean | yes | Voting right at the owners' assembly. |
| `qrReference` | string · nullable |  | Swiss QR-bill reference for contribution payments; null if none. |
| `persons` | [RelatedPersonResponse](#relatedpersonresponse)[] | yes | Persons linked to the ownership relation (owners and residents merged). |
| `currentContribution` | [ContributionResponse](#contributionresponse) · nullable |  | The contribution version effective today; null if none is effective. |

### OwnerStatus

String enum, 3 values.

`upcoming`, `active`, `terminated`

### RelatedPersonResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `personId` | integer | yes | FK to the person resource. Resolve via `getPerson`. |
| `roles` | string: `tenant` \| `owner` \| `resident`[] | yes | Roles this person holds on the entry. `tenant`/`owner` = signatory, `resident` = occupant; a person can hold both. `tenant` appears on rent contracts, `owner` on condo owners. |
| `isPrimary` | boolean | yes | True for the single primary signatory (primary `tenant`/`owner`). Always false for pure residents. |

### ContributionResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `starts` | string (date) | yes | Start of this contribution version. |
| `ends` | string (date) · nullable |  | End of this contribution version; null for the current version. |
| `amount` | string | yes | Contribution per billing cycle. Fixed two-decimal string. |
| `amountMonthly` | string | yes | Derived monthly contribution (`amount / billingCycle`). Fixed two-decimal string. |
| `billingCycle` | integer: `1` \| `3` \| `6` \| `12` | yes | Months per billing cycle. |
| `positions` | [AncillaryExpenseResponse](#ancillaryexpenseresponse)[] | yes | Cost breakdown — same semantics as rent ancillary expenses. |

### AncillaryExpenseResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | Position label as configured on the account. |
| `settlementMode` | [SettlementMode](#settlementmode) | yes |  |
| `amount` | string · nullable |  | Fixed amount as a two-decimal string for `flat` positions; `null` for `settled` positions (those are collected via the gross/net difference). Sent as a string to preserve precision. |

### SettlementMode

String enum, 2 values.

`flat`, `settled`

### PaginationMeta

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `hasMore` | boolean | yes |  |

| `category` | [FileCategory](#filecategory) | yes |  |
| `mimeType` | string | yes | Stored content type. |
| `fileSize` | integer | yes | Size in bytes. |
| `uploadedAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the file was uploaded, ISO 8601. |

### FileCategory

String enum, 18 values.

`finance`, `contracts`, `correspondence`, `protocol`, `personal_information`, `state_documents`, `repairs_and_damage`, `pictures`, `various`, `rules_and_regulations`, `locking_schedule`, `plan`, `service_contracts`, `insurance`, `offer`, `condominium_protocol`, `condominium_meeting`, `profile_image`

# Person

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/persons` | `listPersons` | List persons |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/persons/{id}/files` | `listPersonFiles` | List files of a person |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/persons/{id}` | `getPerson` | Get person details |

## GET /public-api/v1/persons

**List persons** — `listPersons`

Returns persons the calling token can reach. An all-mandate token sees every
person of the customer, including plain contacts with no contract link; a
mandate-restricted token sees only persons reachable via a contract party or
resident link within those mandates. Each row carries derived `roles` and the
current `address`; the address history is available on the detail endpoint.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name1, name2, email, phone. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[role]` | query | string: `tenant` \| `owner` \| `resident` |  | Restricts results to records matching the given role. |
| `filter[mandateId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given mandate id. |
| `filter[propertyId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given property id. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name1` \| `-name1` \| `sortName` \| `-sortName` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name1, sortName. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name1, name2, email, phone
- **Filterable:** `filter[role]` (`tenant`, `owner`, `resident`), `filter[mandateId]`, `filter[propertyId]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name1`, `sortName` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [PersonApiResponse](#personapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "contactType": "natural",
      "name1": "Muster",
      "name2": "Hans",
      "salutation": "unspecified",
      "email": "string",
      "phone": "string",
      "secondEmail": "string",
      "secondPhone": "string",
      "website": "string",
      "communicationChannel": "email",
      "dateOfBirth": "1980-05-12",
      "maritalStatus": "married",
      "placeOfOrigin": "Luzern",
      "contactPersonName": "string",
      "secondContactPersonName": "string",
      "roles": [
        "tenant"
      ],
      "address": {
        "street": "string",
        "houseNumber": "string",
        "postcode": "string",
        "city": "string",
        "country": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/persons/{id}

**Get person details** — `getPerson`

Returns a single person by id, including derived `roles`, the current
`address`, and the full `addresses` history (with scheduled future changes).
Returns 404 when the person does not exist or is outside the token's scope.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**Response** — `200` returns [PersonDetailApiResponse](#persondetailapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Person not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "addresses": [
    {
      "street": "string",
      "houseNumber": "string",
      "postcode": "string",
      "city": "string",
      "country": "string",
      "effectiveFrom": "2022-07-01"
    }
  ],
  "id": 1,
  "contactType": "natural",
  "name1": "Muster",
  "name2": "Hans",
  "salutation": "unspecified",
  "email": "string",
  "phone": "string",
  "secondEmail": "string",
  "secondPhone": "string",
  "website": "string",
  "communicationChannel": "email",
  "dateOfBirth": "1980-05-12",
  "maritalStatus": "married",
  "placeOfOrigin": "Luzern",
  "contactPersonName": "string",
  "secondContactPersonName": "string",
  "roles": [
    "tenant"
  ],
  "address": {
    "street": "string",
    "houseNumber": "string",
    "postcode": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string"
  }
}
```

## Schemas

### PersonApiResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | yes |  |
| `contactType` | [ContactType](#contacttype) | yes |  |
| `name1` | string | yes | Family name (natural) or company name (legal). |
| `name2` | string · nullable |  | Given name(s) (natural) or name addition (legal). Null when not applicable. |
| `salutation` | [Salutation](#salutation) | yes |  |
| `email` | string · nullable |  |  |
| `phone` | string · nullable |  |  |
| `secondEmail` | string · nullable |  |  |
| `secondPhone` | string · nullable |  |  |
| `website` | string · nullable |  |  |
| `communicationChannel` | [CommunicationChannel](#communicationchannel) | yes |  |

| `maritalStatus` | [MaritalStatus](#maritalstatus) · nullable |  | Marital status (natural persons only). Values: `married`, `single`, `divorced`, `widowed`. Null otherwise. |
| `placeOfOrigin` | string · nullable |  | Swiss place of origin / Heimatort (natural persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `contactPersonName` | string · nullable |  | Contact person (legal persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `secondContactPersonName` | string · nullable |  | Second contact person (legal persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `roles` | string: `tenant` \| `owner` \| `resident`[] | yes | Roles derived from the person's active contract relations. Empty when the person has no active tenancy, ownership, or residency. |
| `address` | [AddressDto](#addressdto) · nullable |  | Current effective address, or null when the person has no address on record. |

`natural`, `legal`

`unspecified`, `mrs`, `mr`

| `communicationChannel` | [CommunicationChannel](#communicationchannel) | yes |  |
| `dateOfBirth` | string (date) · nullable |  | Date of birth (natural persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `maritalStatus` | [MaritalStatus](#maritalstatus) · nullable |  | Marital status (natural persons only). Values: `married`, `single`, `divorced`, `widowed`. Null otherwise. |
| `placeOfOrigin` | string · nullable |  | Swiss place of origin / Heimatort (natural persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `contactPersonName` | string · nullable |  | Contact person (legal persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `secondContactPersonName` | string · nullable |  | Second contact person (legal persons only). Null otherwise. |
| `roles` | string: `tenant` \| `owner` \| `resident`[] | yes | Roles derived from the person's active contract relations. Empty when the person has no active tenancy, ownership, or residency. |
| `address` | [AddressDto](#addressdto) · nullable |  | Current effective address, or null when the person has no address on record. |

### PersonAddressDto

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `street` | string | yes |  |
| `houseNumber` | string | yes |  |
| `postcode` | string | yes |  |
| `city` | string | yes |  |
| `country` | string | yes |  |
| `effectiveFrom` | string (date) · nullable |  | Day this address became effective. Null for the baseline address with no recorded start. |

# Property

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/{mode}/properties` | `listProperties` | List properties |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/{mode}/properties/{id}/files` | `listPropertyFiles` | List files of a property |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/{mode}/properties/{id}` | `getProperty` | Get property details |

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/properties

**List properties** — `listProperties`

Returns properties under reachable mandates for the selected `{mode}`.

Properties sit one level below mandates in the resource hierarchy (`Mandate → Property → Building → Object`). Each property carries a `mandateId` FK that resolves via `getMandate`.

Scope with `filter[mandateId]` to restrict to a single mandate. Use `q` for free-text search across name, ZIP and city.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name, postcode, city. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[mandateId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given mandate id. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name` \| `-name` \| `city` \| `-city` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name, city. |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name, postcode, city
- **Filterable:** `filter[mandateId]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name`, `city` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [PropertyApiResponse](#propertyapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "mandateId": 1,
      "managerId": 42,
      "name": "string",
      "postcode": "string",
      "city": "string",
      "canton": "ZH",
      "country": "AF",
      "egrid": "CH123456789012",
      "isActive": true
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/properties/{id}/files

**List files of a property** — `listPropertyFiles`

Returns the files attached to a property. Visible exactly when the property itself is
visible via `getProperty`; orphaned files and files of other customers never appear.

Use `getFile` for a file's owners and `downloadFile` for its binary.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[category]` | query | string enum (18 values) |  | Restricts results to records matching the given category. One of: `finance`, `contracts`, `correspondence`, `protocol`, `personal_information`, `state_documents`, `repairs_and_damage`, `pictures`, `various`, `rules_and_regulations`, `locking_schedule`, `plan`, `service_contracts`, `insurance`, `offer`, `condominium_protocol`, `condominium_meeting`, `profile_image`. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name` \| `-name` \| `uploadedAt` \| `-uploadedAt` \| `fileSize` \| `-fileSize` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name, uploadedAt, fileSize. |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name
- **Filterable:** `filter[category]` (`finance`, `contracts`, `correspondence`, `protocol`, `personal_information`, `state_documents`, `repairs_and_damage`, `pictures`, `various`, `rules_and_regulations`, `locking_schedule`, `plan`, `service_contracts`, `insurance`, `offer`, `condominium_protocol`, `condominium_meeting`, `profile_image`)
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name`, `uploadedAt`, `fileSize` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [FileApiResponse](#fileapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Parent resource not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 4711,
      "name": "Hausordnung.pdf",
      "category": "finance",
      "mimeType": "application/pdf",
      "fileSize": 184320,
      "uploadedAt": "2026-03-14T09:12:00+01:00"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/properties/{id}

**Get property details** — `getProperty`

Returns a single property by id, including its address, canton, EGRID, and active flag.

Use `listProperties` for discovery when the id is unknown. The `mandateId` FK links back to `getMandate`; `getBuilding` / `listBuildings` traverse down to buildings under this property.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**Response** — `200` returns [PropertyApiResponse](#propertyapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Property not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "mandateId": 1,
  "managerId": 42,
  "name": "string",
  "postcode": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "canton": "ZH",
  "country": "AF",
  "egrid": "CH123456789012",
  "isActive": true
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/{mode}/rooms

**List rooms** — `listRooms`

Returns the rooms of rental objects reachable for the selected `{mode}`. Each room
carries an `objectId` FK that resolves via `getObject`.

Scope with `filter[objectId]`, `filter[buildingId]`, or `filter[propertyId]`; use `q`
to search by room name.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[objectId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given object id. |
| `filter[buildingId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given building id. |
| `filter[propertyId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given property id. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name` \| `-name` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name. |
| `mode` | path | string: `rent` \| `condo` | yes | Business domain for the request. Use `rent` for rental-management data, `condo` for condominium-ownership data. The selected mode constrains every related resource. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name
- **Filterable:** `filter[objectId]`, `filter[buildingId]`, `filter[propertyId]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |

## GET /public-api/v1/service-providers

**List service providers** — `listServiceProviders`

Returns the service providers (contractors) the calling token can reach. An
all-mandate token sees every provider of the customer, including ones with no
property assignment; a mandate-restricted token sees only providers assigned to
a property within those mandates. Filter with `filter[propertyId]` or
`filter[domain]`; search across name and email with `q`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name1, name2, email. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[propertyId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to records belonging to the given property id. |
| `filter[domain]` | query | string |  | Restricts results to records matching the given domain. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name1` \| `-name1` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name1. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name1, name2, email
- **Filterable:** `filter[propertyId]`, `filter[domain]`
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name1` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [ServiceProviderApiResponse](#serviceproviderapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |

| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json

  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,

      "name2": "string",

      "email": "string",
      "phone": "string",
      "secondEmail": "string",
      "secondPhone": "string",
      "website": "string",
```

# User

| Method | Path | Operation | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/users` | `listUsers` | List users |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/users/{id}/files` | `listUserFiles` | List files of a user |
| GET | `/public-api/v1/users/{id}` | `getUser` | Get user details |

## GET /public-api/v1/users

**List users** — `listUsers`

Returns the property-management staff accounts the calling token can reach.

Users are referenced by `managerId` on properties. A token with access to all mandates sees every (non-support) user of the customer; a token restricted to specific mandates sees only users assigned to an in-scope mandate, plus managers of in-scope properties.

Use `q` for free-text search across first name, last name, and email. Narrow with `filter[status]`, `filter[mandateId]`, or `filter[role]`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter[status]` | query | string: `invited` \| `active` \| `disabled` |  | Restricts results to users with the given lifecycle status. |
| `filter[mandateId]` | query | integer |  | Restricts results to users assigned to the given mandate id. |
| `filter[role]` | query | string: `account_owner` \| `manager` |  | Restricts results by system role. `manager` matches every user; `account_owner` matches account owners only. |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: firstName, lastName, email. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `lastName` \| `-lastName` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, lastName. |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** firstName, lastName, email
- **Filterable:** `filter[status]` (`invited`, `active`, `disabled`), `filter[mandateId]`, `filter[role]` (`account_owner`, `manager`)
- **Sortable:** `id`, `lastName` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [UserApiResponse](#userapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "salutation": "unspecified",
      "firstName": "string",
      "lastName": "string",
      "email": "string",
      "phone": "+41 79 555 11 22",
      "jobTitle": "string",
      "language": "de",
      "status": "invited",
      "roles": [
        "manager"
      ],
      "mandateIds": [
        1
      ]
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/users/{id}/files

**List files of a user** — `listUserFiles`

Returns the files attached to a user. The only `category` a user file can have is
`profile_image`. Visible exactly when the user itself is visible via `getUser`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | integer |  | Maximum number of items to return. limit=0 is accepted and silently treated as 1. Values above the maximum are capped to it. Default `30`. Maximum `100`. |
| `offset` | query | integer |  | Number of items to skip. Use with limit for pagination. Default `0`. |
| `q` | query | string |  | Free-text search across: name. Case-insensitive partial match; every word must match one of these fields (so "Peter Berger" matches first and last name in separate fields). Combine with filter[...] keys to narrow further. |
| `filter[category]` | query | string enum (18 values) |  | Restricts results to records matching the given category. One of: `finance`, `contracts`, `correspondence`, `protocol`, `personal_information`, `state_documents`, `repairs_and_damage`, `pictures`, `various`, `rules_and_regulations`, `locking_schedule`, `plan`, `service_contracts`, `insurance`, `offer`, `condominium_protocol`, `condominium_meeting`, `profile_image`. |
| `sort` | query | string: `id` \| `-id` \| `name` \| `-name` \| `uploadedAt` \| `-uploadedAt` \| `fileSize` \| `-fileSize` |  | Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order (e.g. `-id`). Allowed: id, name, uploadedAt, fileSize. |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**List capabilities**

- **Searchable (`q`):** name
- **Filterable:** `filter[category]` (`finance`, `contracts`, `correspondence`, `protocol`, `personal_information`, `state_documents`, `repairs_and_damage`, `pictures`, `various`, `rules_and_regulations`, `locking_schedule`, `plan`, `service_contracts`, `insurance`, `offer`, `condominium_protocol`, `condominium_meeting`, `profile_image`)
- **Sortable:** `id`, `name`, `uploadedAt`, `fileSize` (prefix `-` for descending)
- **Page size:** default `30`, maximum `100`

**Response** — `200` returns a list envelope around [FileApiResponse](#fileapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `400` | Invalid query parameters |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | Parent resource not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 4711,
      "name": "Hausordnung.pdf",
      "category": "finance",
      "mimeType": "application/pdf",
      "fileSize": 184320,
      "uploadedAt": "2026-03-14T09:12:00+01:00"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "limit": 30,
      "offset": 0,
      "total": 1,
      "hasMore": false
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /public-api/v1/users/{id}

**Get user details** — `getUser`

Returns a single user by id, including salutation, contact details, preferred language, lifecycle status, system roles, and assigned mandate ids.

Use `listUsers` for discovery when the id is unknown. A `managerId` reference on a property resolves here. With a restricted token a referenced user can fall outside the visible set; consumers must tolerate an unresolvable reference (`404`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | yes |  |

**Response** — `200` returns [UserApiResponse](#userapiresponse).

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | OK |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Token cannot access this resource |
| `404` | User not found |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |

**Example response**

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "salutation": "unspecified",
  "firstName": "string",
  "lastName": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "phone": "+41 79 555 11 22",
  "jobTitle": "string",
  "language": "de",
  "status": "invited",
  "roles": [
    "manager"
  ],
  "mandateIds": [
    1
  ]
}
```

## Schemas

### UserApiResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | yes |  |
| `salutation` | [Salutation](#salutation) | yes |  |
| `firstName` | string | yes |  |
| `lastName` | string | yes |  |
| `email` | string | yes |  |
| `phone` | string · nullable |  | Mobile phone number. Null when not set. |
| `jobTitle` | string · nullable |  |  |
| `language` | [UserLanguage](#userlanguage) | yes |  |
| `status` | [UserStatus](#userstatus) | yes |  |
| `roles` | string: `manager` \| `account_owner`[] | yes | System roles. Every user is `manager`; account owners additionally hold `account_owner`. |
| `mandateIds` | integer[] | yes | Ids of the mandates this user is assigned to. |

### Salutation

String enum, 3 values.

`unspecified`, `mrs`, `mr`

### UserLanguage

String enum, 4 values.

`de`, `en`, `fr`, `it`

### UserStatus

String enum, 3 values.

`invited`, `active`, `disabled`

### PaginationMeta

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | yes |  |
| `offset` | integer | yes |  |
| `total` | integer | yes |  |
| `hasMore` | boolean | yes |  |

### FileApiResponse

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | integer | yes | Resolve metadata via `getFile` and the binary via `downloadFile`. |
| `name` | string | yes | File name as uploaded. |
| `category` | [FileCategory](#filecategory) | yes |  |
| `mimeType` | string | yes | Stored content type. |
| `fileSize` | integer | yes | Size in bytes. |
| `uploadedAt` | string (date-time) | yes | When the file was uploaded, ISO 8601. |

### FileCategory

String enum, 18 values.

`finance`, `contracts`, `correspondence`, `protocol`, `personal_information`, `state_documents`, `repairs_and_damage`, `pictures`, `various`, `rules_and_regulations`, `locking_schedule`, `plan`, `service_contracts`, `insurance`, `offer`, `condominium_protocol`, `condominium_meeting`, `profile_image`
